modal_definition.differential_to_common: Sdc approximately branch self asymmetry for reciprocal pair

key_observations: M7B suppresses branch asymmetry/Sdc to roughly 4-8 percent of the full-E2C deviation across all five anchors.
M7B does not significantly change the branch mutual-average term at low/mid band and changes it only moderately at the upper-band anchor.
M7B increases the self-average deviation to roughly 1.7-2.4 times full E2C.
M7B increases differential Sdd deviation to roughly 2.25-3.60 times full E2C, with penalty growing toward the upper band.

Therefore the large residual after M7B is not primarily branch imbalance or direct inter-branch mutual coupling; it is a symmetric local self-loading/differential-impedance penalty introduced when the under-pad return reference is removed.

first_principles_model.full_e2c: CIN pad couples capacitively to a non-ideal/shared return network. Unequal effective return potentials/impedances convert differential energy to common mode and create branch imbalance.
first_principles_model.m7b: Removing backside ground beneath the CIN pad weakens that coupling, so asymmetry and mode conversion collapse. But it also removes the intended local RF reference/shunt capacitance, creating a broadband symmetric discontinuity in each branch.
first_principles_model.frequency_trend: The M7B differential penalty increases toward higher frequency, consistent with a local capacitive/reference-plane perturbation whose effect grows with frequency rather than a narrow new resonance.
first_principles_model.implication: The next corrective must preserve local pad-to-return reference while preventing that local return from participating strongly in the shared/global return network.

mechanism_ranking.larger_shared_return_path: STILL_PLAUSIBLE_UNDERLYING_FULL_E2C_CONTRIBUTOR, but cannot be isolated until the M7B self-loading penalty is removed.

next_design_principle.preferred: Retain copper under/near CIN pad as a controlled local return reference, while isolating its lateral/shared-current path to the broader backside ground with a moat/tongue/island topology that remains galvanically tied to the branch-local package/via return.
avoid: Do not enlarge the M7B aperture.
Do not repeat upstream inner-edge setback.
Do not change inter-branch spacing first.
Do not optimize global ground shape before fixing the M7B-created self-loading penalty.
